basic_info.description: Transparent pricing!! Experience the perfect blend of historic charm and modern sophistication and elegance in this exceptional 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo. Nestled in the sought-after St. Paul's Common, this rarely available residence features an open floor plan highlighted by exposed red brick walls, soaring ceilings, and elegant arched windows that flood the space with natural light. Enjoy a beautifully updated kitchen and spa-inspired bathrooms, seamlessly integrated with the building's timeless architectural character. The spacious living and dining area is ideal for both everyday living and stylish entertaining. Additional conveniences include an in-unit washer and dryer and a dedicated one-car garage parking space in a gated building with security features for peace of mind. Enjoy the added benefit of elevator access and sunny shared gardens. This is a unique opportunity to own a piece of history without compromising on modern comfort and modern living. This prime location offers easy access to local conveniences, restaurants, stores and public transportation and tech shuttle stops, making your commute to downtown San Francisco and Silicon Valley a breeze.
